title: Urd site.json
description: The site root: identity, page registry, navigation, grid and theme. The contract is described in docs/SCHEMA.md.

icon.description: Site icon (favicon): path in media/ (data URL in draft). Additive field from v0.5.

setup.description: Additive from v0.6: true in the template's default content triggers the setup wizard in admin; the wizard removes the field on completion. Replaces the old string matching on the template's default name.

layout.description: Page layout (additive from v0.7, ADR-0018): the content is bound by a design width with full-width section backgrounds. Filled in by the site migration 1 -> 2.

contentWidth.description: Design width in px, or 'full' for unbound full width (Urd's behavior before v0.7). A number rather than a CSS length, since the editor computes the preview's target width from it.

gutter.description: Minimum side margin between the content surface and the viewport edge, in PERCENT OF THE VIEWPORT WIDTH (vw). Was px until schemaVersion 2. Applies only above the mobile breakpoint, and only has effect where contentWidth does not bind yet.

tokens.description: Groups of design tokens; mapped to CSS variables --urd-<group>-<name>

scheme.description: The main theme's lightness (additive from v0.6): what the light/dark toggle and prefers-color-scheme treat the main tokens as.

alt.description: Alternate theme for the light/dark toggle (additive from v0.6): token groups that override the main tokens in the opposite mode of scheme. If the field exists, the nav shows the toggle.

auto.description: Additive from v0.6: if true the alt colors are auto-derived from the main theme (inverted lightness) and re-derived when a main color changes; false/omitted = the owner controls the alt colors.

tokens.description: Same shape as theme.tokens; omitted values inherit the main theme

pages.description: The page registry - nav, routing and admin panels are derived from it

noindex.description: Hide the page from search engines (additive from v0.7): meta robots noindex, no canonical, and omitted from sitemap.xml

layout.description: Placement of the menu items (the logo always comes first). Additive field from v0.5.

sticky.description: The menu follows along when scrolling down (false = sits only at the top). Additive field from v0.5.

scroll.description: Scroll behavior for the sticky top bar (additive from v0.6): shrink = the menu shrinks after some scrolling, hide = hidden when scrolling down and shown again when scrolling up (always visible at the top). Omitted = normal. Ignored for the side variant and when sticky is false.

variant.description: The menu's form (additive from v0.6): bar = full-width strip, floating = pill floating above the content, floating-square = the same without rounded corners, floating-tab = floating with a square top and only the two lower corners rounded (hangs down from the top), side-left/side-right = fixed column along the edge (mobile and narrow windows fall back to a top bar with a burger).

overlay.description: Place the full-width bar on top of the first section instead of in its own band above it, so a transparent menu reveals the hero behind it (additive from v0.6). Applies only to variant bar; the first section should have enough clearance at the top. Floating/side variants already sit outside the flow.

cart.description: Shopping cart in the tools cluster (the shop, additive from v0.7): button with a count badge that opens the cart drawer. Omitted = no cart in the menu.

href.description: The checkout page's path (the drawer's "Go to checkout" link); empty = no link

currency.description: The currency word in the drawer (default kr)

style.description: The menu's appearance (additive from v0.5). Omitted fields = default.

background.description: Layer-based background (additive from v0.6): takes over the surface when present; the old bg/image fields apply only without layers (backward compat).

bg.description: Background color: theme token or raw color (old simple form; replaced by background layers in the editor)

textColor.description: Text color in the menu (empty = the theme's text color)

hover.description: Hover style for the menu links (additive from v0.6): standard = accent color, underline = sliding underline, pill = rounded background, lift-plain = lift without glow, lift = lift with glow.

hoverGlow.description: Glow strength for the lift hover style (additive from v0.6); the glow sits behind the text.

glow.description: Glow around the floating pill (additive from v0.6; applies only to variant floating).

topGap.description: Space above the floating pill (additive from v0.6; false = the pill sits flush at the top).

image.description: Background image in the menu (additive from v0.6): path in media/ (data URL in draft). bg/bgOpacity is laid as a veil over the image.

imageOpacity.description: Image strength (additive from v0.6): below 1 the image is faded toward the background color.

imageY.description: Vertical image crop (additive from v0.6): 0 = top of the image, 100 = bottom.

imageX.description: Horizontal image crop (additive from v0.6): 0 = left edge, 100 = right. Matters most in the side column.

subImage.description: The background image is also shown in the submenu and the mobile panel (additive from v0.6; the default is the color veil only).

subStyle.description: The submenu's design (additive from v0.6): card = card with shadow, flat = plain surface, pills = pill items, lines = list with dividers, flyout = flyout in full menu width.

subOpen.description: How the submenus open on a mouse device (additive from v0.7): hover = the pointer opens and closes them, stay = the pointer opens them and only a click, another item or a click outside closes them, click = only a click opens and closes them. Touch always uses click.

subPillColor.description: The pill items' color when subStyle is pills: theme token or raw color (additive from v0.6; the default is the submenu's surface).

subColumns.description: Columns in the submenu (additive from v0.6): the items are laid out in a grid (2 gives 2x2, 2x3 and so on).

sideAlign.description: Text alignment of the items in the side column (additive from v0.6).

sidePlacement.description: Vertical placement of the menu list in the side column (additive from v0.6). Separate field: layout applies only to the top bar.

width.description: The side column's width in px (additive from v0.6); adjusted by dragging the column edge in the editor.

hoverColor.description: The hover effect's color (underline/pill surface/glow): theme token or raw color (additive from v0.6; default accent).

hoverTextColor.description: The text color on hover: theme token or raw color (additive from v0.6; default accent).

size.description: The menu's size (additive from v0.6): padding and font in four steps; md = the current look.

padY.description: Thickness: vertical padding in px (additive from v0.7, ADR-0023); overrides the size preset's padding and is drawn as set in every variant. Omitted = the preset. Bar and floating variants.

textSize.description: Menu text size in px (additive from v0.7); overrides the size preset's font. Omitted = the preset.

padX.description: Side padding in px (additive from v0.7); also the mobile panel and the side-to-bar fallback. Omitted = clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem).

gap.description: Space between the menu items in px (additive from v0.7). Omitted = 1.25rem.

inset.description: The bar's contents line up with the content edge (site.layout.contentWidth and the gutter) while the background keeps the full width (additive from v0.7); desktop only, variant bar only.

pillWidth.description: The floating menu's maximum width in px, or content = the site's content width (additive from v0.7). Omitted = 1100. Floating variants only; ignored at the mobile breakpoint.

shrinkTo.description: The padding factor in the compact state when nav.scroll is shrink (additive from v0.7).

shrinkLogo.description: The logo image shrinks with the menu in the compact state (additive from v0.7).

border.description: A border on the bar (additive from v0.7); omitted = none. Bar and floating variants.

color.description: Theme token or raw colour (omitted = a hairline in the text colour)

shadow.description: A drop shadow under the top bar (additive from v0.7); omitted = none. Variant bar only (the floating menu has glow).

atTop.description: Transparent at the top (additive from v0.7): the menu draws no surface, blur, border or shadow until the page has scrolled past the top zone; omitted = the surface is always drawn. Bar and floating variants only; ignored for the side column.

radius.description: The floating menu's corner rounding in px (additive from v0.7); omitted = the variant's preset (pill 999, square 0, tab the theme's medium radius). Floating variants only.

mobile.description: Overrides at the mobile breakpoint (additive from v0.7); omitted fields = same as desktop. Chosen by nav.js at render time.

padY.description: Thickness in px at the mobile breakpoint

textSize.description: Menu text size in px at the mobile breakpoint

value.description: Text (type text/both) or image URL (type image)

image.description: Image URL when type is both

mobileSize.description: Image height in px at the mobile breakpoint (additive from v0.7; omitted = size)

font.description: Font stack for the logo text (empty = the theme's heading font)

radius.description: The image's corner rounding in px

href.description: Link target when page is not set: external link (https/mailto/tel) or site-internal path/anchor to a section (#section-id, /path#section-id; additive from v0.6)

children.description: Submenu, one level (additive from v0.6). An item with children but no page/href is a pure opener (the whole item opens the submenu); with a target of its own the link is shown plus an arrow button.

href.description: Link target when page is not set: external link (https/mailto/tel) or site-internal path/anchor to a section (#section-id, /path#section-id; additive from v0.6)

footer.description: Shared footer on all pages (additive field from v0.5). Omitted/hidden = no footer.

hideOn.description: Page ids where the footer is hidden (per-page exception, additive from v0.6); the default (absent) is visible on all pages when show is on.

text.description: Lines separated by line breaks; each line becomes a paragraph. Backward-compatible simple form

brand.description: The brand column (additive from v0.6): title, tagline and optional uploaded logo.

mode.description: The brand is shown as text, uploaded logo (image), or both (logo + text). Mirrors the nav logo. Additive from v0.6.

logo.description: Uploaded logo: path in media/ (data URL in draft). Shown when mode is image/both.

columns.description: Link columns (additive from v0.6). A column without valid links is not rendered.

wide.description: Force the column wide (two-column); otherwise auto at > 6 links (additive from v0.6).

href.description: Link target when page is not set: external link (https/mailto/tel) or site-internal path/anchor to a section (#section-id, /path#section-id; additive from v0.6)

social.description: Social links (additive from v0.6): icon id from the icon library + URL (http/https/mailto/tel).

copyright.description: Bottom line (additive from v0.6); falls back to text when absent

bg.description: Background color: theme color token or custom value (old simple form; replaced by background layers in the editor). Default = the theme's surface

background.description: Layer-based background (additive from v0.6): takes over the surface when present; the old bg field applies only without layers (backward compat).

baseline.description: The bottom line's optional right-side links (additive from v0.6): privacy/terms/"Made with Urd".

linkRow.description: Doormat link row: one centered row of links (additive from v0.6; the Centered and Big CTA templates).

columnsAlign.description: Alignment of a wide (two-column) column's heading (additive from v0.6).

cta.description: Call to action (additive from v0.6): button (link) or newsletter (email field + modern endpoint submission).

page.description: Button target: id from the page registry

href.description: Button target when page is not set: external link/mailto or site-internal path/anchor to a section (#section-id; additive from v0.6)

endpoint.description: Newsletter endpoint (Formspree/Mailchimp/Buttondown/own Cloudflare function); sent with fetch (POST JSON). An external host requires connect-src in _headers (ADR-0006).

recipient.description: Mailto fallback when endpoint is missing

href.description: Link target when page is not set: external link (https/mailto/tel) or site-internal path/anchor to a section (#section-id, /path#section-id; additive from v0.6)

grid.description: Snapping tool: square cells. Never affects placement.

background.description: Layer-based background (color/gradient/glow/grain/image/slideshow) - the same model as the section background. Additive from v0.6; shared by nav and footer.
